title: Grayscale Converts Bitcoin Miners ETF into New AI Infrastructure Fund
summary:
The crypto asset manager has transitioned its $MNRS ticker from tracking cryptocurrency mining to a new focus on artificial intelligence hardware. The restructured fund, now known as the Grayscale AI Compute ETF ($GCPU), invests in firms providing GPU cloud services, high-performance computing and data centers. Its top holdings as of Oct. 27 include DigitalOcean at 8.93%, Nebius at 8.51%, CoreWeave at 8.34% and Hut 8 at 7.74%.

The fund conversion took place in September and mirrors a wider industry movement where Bitcoin mining companies leverage existing power capacity and data center footprints to support the computing requirements of the AI sector.

⚡️INSIGHT: Grayscale makes a BIG pivot from Bitcoin mining to AI computing.

Last September, the crypto asset manager converted its Bitcoin Miners ETF ($MNRS) into the Grayscale AI Compute ETF ($GCPU).

The AI infra-focused fund includes companies involved in AI data centers, GPU cloud services and high-performance computing.

As of October 27, its major holdings include:
- DigitalOcean ($DOCN) – 8.93%
- Nebius ($NBIS) – 8.51%
- CoreWeave ($CRWV) – 8.34%
- Hut 8 ($HUT) – 7.74%

The shift reflects a growing trend of Bitcoin mining companies moving into AI infrastructure, where existing power capacity and data centers can support AI computing.
